head: a81a04f4bc59c6b5568a05cc90558ff79d06a4a9
change_summary: drain stdout and stderr concurrently while retaining at most 1 MiB per stream and discarding excess bytes
bound output completion with an independent two-second drain deadline
place each supervised command in a dedicated POSIX process group and kill that group after timeout or leader exit
wait the direct leader on every cleanup path without installing process-wide subreaper state
share the same supervisor between the timeout runner and the resource-envelope runner
retain the truthful SupervisedProcess classification and existing fail-closed Container requirement for untrusted generated code

workflow_runs.name: CI
steps: NNIS adapter format, check, Clippy and host tests

discarded_attempts.reason: rustfmt failed before compilation; later gates were skipped
all workflows passed, but exact review found unsafe process-wide subreaper adoption; superseded and not merged
rustfmt failed after the review correction; later gates were skipped
all workflows passed, then documentation was narrowed to the exact process-group boundary; superseded before merge

review.finding: process-wide subreaper could adopt an escaped descendant that group-scoped waitpid would never reap
review.resolution: removed PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER and group-scoped waitpid; group cleanup waits only the direct leader and leaves orphan reaping to system init

acceptance: stdout and stderr are drained simultaneously with independent one-MiB retention limits
pipe completion has a deadline independent from the candidate wall-clock timeout
the dedicated process group is terminated after timeout and after normal leader exit, and the direct leader is always waited
real-process regressions cover simultaneous pipe saturation, capture bounds, timeout and a pipe-holding in-group descendant
the exact PR head and exact integrated target commit passed every configured workflow
limitations: this is resource supervision, not a hostile-code sandbox

a descendant that deliberately leaves the dedicated process group is outside the claimed boundary; untrusted generated code still requires Container-or-stronger isolation and fails closed on this backend
group-member orphans are reaped by system init rather than by process-wide Forge subreaper state, avoiding adoption of unrelated or escaped children
the main branch is unprotected and declares no required checks; no protection is claimed or bypassed
